title: System Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the SystemConfigManager, defining system-wide operational parameters.

serviceManager.description: Configuration settings for the service manager.

retryDelaysMs.description: Array of delays in milliseconds for retrying service operations. Example: [1000, 3000, 5000].

restartBackoffMs.description: Array of backoff delays in milliseconds before attempting to restart a failed service. Example: [5000, 10000, 30000].

commandMaxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for command execution. Example: 3.

commandRetryDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between retries for command execution. Example: 1000.

created.description: Timestamp when the configuration was created.
